body:
## Problem

`/home/runner/work/MetalDrummerGear/MetalDrummerGear/packages/frontend/data/evolutionTimeline.js:448-464` (entry `timeline-1993-meshuggah-contradictions`):

```js
{
  id: 'timeline-1993-meshuggah-contradictions',
  year: 1993,
  month: 10,
  decade: '1990s',
  title: 'Meshuggah: Tomas Haake Begins His Legacy',
  description: 'Tomas Haake\'s polyrhythmic innovations on "Contradictions Collapse" hint at the djent revolution to come.',
  ...
  album: 'Contradictions Collapse',
  ...
}
```

This entry states `year: 1993` for the release of Meshuggah's debut album "Contradictions Collapse." That album was released in **1991**, and Tomas Haake joined Meshuggah in **1990** — both two years before the year this entry claims.

## Ground truth

`/home/runner/work/MetalDrummerGear/MetalDrummerGear/packages/frontend/data/bands.js`:
- Line 413: `{ drummer: "tomas-haake", period: "1990-present", notes: "Replaced founding drummer Niklas Lundgren in 1990; has recorded every Meshuggah studio album since the 1991 debut Contradictions Collapse" }`
- Line 416: `{ title: "Contradictions Collapse", year: 1991, drummer: "tomas-haake" }`
- Line 430 (bio prose): "...with drummer Tomas Haake joining in 1990 to replace original drummer Niklas Lundgren. The band's 1991 debut, Contradictions Collapse..."

Four independent fields in `bands.js` agree on 1990 (join) / 1991 (album). `evolutionTimeline.js`'s `year: 1993` is the sole outlier.

Note: closed issue #7544 already touched this exact entry, but only fixed the `gearNotes` field (removed a pre-endorsement-era brand claim) — it explicitly did not touch the `year` field, which remains wrong.

## Fix

In `/home/runner/work/MetalDrummerGear/MetalDrummerGear/packages/frontend/data/evolutionTimeline.js` at line 449, change:
```js
year: 1993,
```
to:
```js
year: 1991,
```

Also update `month: 10` if a more accurate release month is known from `bands.js` or other sourced data; otherwise leave as-is (no ground truth gives a month, so don't invent one — if no source, consider dropping `month` or leaving a hedge, implementer's call, just don't fabricate a new one).

## Verify

1. `sed -n '448,465p' packages/frontend/data/evolutionTimeline.js` shows `year: 1991`.
2. `grep -n "timeline-1993-meshuggah" packages/frontend/data/evolutionTimeline.js` returns no hits (id can stay as-is or be renamed to `timeline-1991-...` — renaming is optional, check for any other file referencing this id by `grep -rn "timeline-1993-meshuggah-contradictions"` before renaming, since the id is also used as a React key / anchor).
3. Confirm no other field in this entry now contradicts the corrected year.
4. `node -e "require('./packages/frontend/data/evolutionTimeline.js')"` (or equivalent build/lint step) still parses cleanly.

## Done

`evolutionTimeline.js`'s Meshuggah/Contradictions Collapse entry states `year: 1991`, consistent with `bands.js`.

title: SEO: evolutionTimeline.js dates Tomas Haake's 'Contradictions Collapse' to 1993 — album released 1991
